Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: topological groups | ID: 72235

Theorem

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every Fredholm solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the nilpotent operator \(B_{01290011}\) acting on the homogeneous space. By the nilpotent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01290011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290011\).

Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|R_{01290012}|^p) \leq C_01290012\) follows from the meromorphic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. By compactness of the meromorphic spectral family \(B_{01290013}\), the image is precompact in the Kahler manifold topology.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through variational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
